distance: 5th-nearest Euclidean distance after frozen source feature standardization and L2 normalization of 768-dimensional E3
reason_for_lower_input_use: A standard independent distance detector may use a subset of the common information budget; no new external information is supplied.
reference_bank: Same admitted target commissioning rows and same 7200s bank as C5, with identical original times/frame lineage. No extra history or post-window absorption.
point_policy: Point kNN, including repeated stages in a component. No C5 two-component requirement; fewer than five legal reference points yields RAW fallback.
query_causality: Complete bank available only when reference_end < query timestamp, and frozen same-capture bank-end-frame/individual-frame constraints pass.
unsupported_or_reference_replay: RAW fallback, retained in reported populations
SYN_guard: Not imposed on this independent detector; unlike C5, it replaces the alarm using normal-distance score where available.

calibration.population: Existing 179602 source CAL, source-own device/protocol/causal banks
calibration.normal_weights: Frozen core.class_weights on source normal CAL rows
calibration.targets: Four original RAW source normal weighted FPR working points
calibration.threshold_rule: Hold RAW-fallback FP mass fixed. Select smallest observed finite distance cut with strict distance > cut weighted FPR no greater than RAW target; group equal distances; conservative ties. If all finite rows fit the target use nextafter(min,-inf); if none scored use null and RAW fallback.
calibration.attack_use: Report source own-bank recall after normal-only threshold lock; attacks do not select thresholds. No extra donor pressure task.
calibration.head_interpretation: One common distance score at four RAW source working points, not four independent neural heads

comparison_scope: Independent standard nonparametric reference comparator. RAW and same-bank p1 remain separately required; p1 is an ablation. This comparator alone does not establish that the eventual paper's complete strong-baseline portfolio is ready.
